day: A short date (month and day); `at` is the date.
load-failed: Error in the room's pins panel when its pinned facts couldn't be loaded.
outcome.pinned: Toast after pinning a fact. "the socio" is the room's AI agent.
outcome.proposed: Toast after a member proposes a fact for an admin to pin.
outcome.unchanged: Toast when the fact pinned or proposed is already pinned or waiting as a proposal.
outcome.done: Toast after another change to a pin (an edit, an unpin, an approval…) worked.
title: Heading of the room's panel of pinned facts: short facts the room's AI socio reads with every message.
description: Line under the heading for a read-only room. _loading: before the pins load. _manage: the reader is a room admin. _propose: the reader is a member.
loading: In the pins panel while the pinned facts load.
pinned: Section heading; `pins` is how many are pinned, `max` the most allowed.
pinned-list: Accessible name of the list of pinned facts.
nothing: In the list of pinned facts when the room has none.
chars: How much of the pins' character budget is used.
pin-a-fact: Section heading for a room admin's form.
propose-a-fact: Section heading for a member's form.
pin: Button for a room admin: pins the typed fact (also beside a fact in the room's notes).
propose: Button for a member: proposes the typed fact for a room admin to pin (also beside a fact in the notes).
pin-failed: Toast in the pins panel when pinning (or proposing) a typed fact, or a fact from the room's notes, failed.
proposed: Section heading; `n` is how many proposals wait.
proposed-list: Accessible name of the list of proposed facts waiting for an admin.
pin-row.save: Button that saves an edit of a pinned fact.
pin-row.propose-change: Button that sends a member's edit of a pin as a proposal.
pin-row.change-failed: Toast when saving an edit of a pinned fact, or proposing a change to it, failed in the pins panel.
pin-row.pinned-by: Under a pin; `name` is who pinned it. _you: the reader did.
pin-row.version: Under a pin: which version of it this is.
pin-row.from-notes: Under a pin: it came from the room's notes, not someone's own words.
pin-row.edit: Button on a pinned fact: opens it for editing.
pin-row.suggest: Button for a member to propose a change to a pin.
pin-row.unpin: Button on a pinned fact: removes it from the pins.
pin-row.unpin-failed: Toast when Unpin on a pinned fact failed in the pins panel.
pin-row.history: Button on a pinned fact: shows its versions and who changed it.
pin-row.hide-history: The same button once the history shows: hides it.
former-member: Stands in for the name of someone who left the workspace.
status.proposed: A version's state: proposed, waiting for an admin.
status.pinned: A version's state: it is the one in use.
status.superseded: A version's state: a newer version replaced it.
status.unpinned: A version's state: the fact was unpinned.
status.rejected: A version's state: an admin turned the proposal down.
status.withdrawn: A version's state: whoever proposed it took it back.
line.pinned: Start of a pin's history line; `name` is who pinned it.
line.edited: Start of a pin's history line; `name` is who edited it.
line.proposed: Start of a pin's history line; `name` is who proposed it.
line.joined: Joins the history line's parts ("Proposed by Ada, approved by Bob") with commas, no "and".
history.failed: Error under a pinned fact when its history (its versions and who changed it) couldn't be loaded.
line.turned-down: Lowercase: follows a comma in the history line; `name` is who.
line.approved: Lowercase: follows a comma in the history line; `name` is who.
line.unpinned: Lowercase: follows a comma in the history line; `name` is who.
line.replaced: Lowercase: follows a comma in the history line; `name` is who.
history.list: Accessible name of a pin's list of versions.
history.version: Small badge: "v" and a version number.
history.proposal: Small badge on a history row that is a proposal, not a version.
proposal.proposed-by: Under a proposal; `name` is who proposed it. _you: the reader did.
proposal.changes: Under a proposal that edits a pin; `text` is the pin's current words.
proposal.changes-stale: Under a proposal whose pin changed after it was proposed.
proposal.approve: Button for a room admin on a proposal: pins it.
proposal.approve-failed: Toast when a room admin's approval of a proposed fact (which pins it) failed in the pins panel.
proposal.turn-down: Button: an admin declines the proposal.
proposal.turn-down-failed: Toast when a room admin's Turn down on a proposed fact failed in the pins panel.
proposal.withdraw: Button on the reader's own proposal: takes it back.
proposal.withdraw-failed: Toast when the reader's Withdraw on their own proposed fact failed in the pins panel.
fact.label: Hidden label of the fact's text box.
fact.placeholder: Example fact in the empty text box.
fact.limit: Hint beside the text box; `max` is the character limit.
fact.cancel: Button beside the fact's text box while editing a pin: closes it without saving.
notes.title: Section heading: the notes the AI keeps on the room's older messages.
notes.none: Shown before there are notes. "Socio" is the product; "a socio" is an AI agent.
notes.current: `version` is the notes' version; `count` how many turns of the conversation they cover.
notes.facts: Accessible name of the list of facts in the notes.
notes.pin-fact: Accessible name of Pin beside a fact; `fact` is its words.
notes.propose-fact: Accessible name of Propose beside a fact; `fact` is its words.
notes.versions: Expandable list's heading; `n` is how many versions.
notes.version-turns: A notes version: `version` its number, `from` and `to` the turns it covers.
notes.by: After a notes version: `name` is the socio that wrote it.
notes.in-turn: After notes.by: `name` is the person whose message it ran for.
notes.fallback: After a notes version: the AI model failed, so the notes were kept in a simpler form.
